name: shadynotes-golinks
description: Campaign short links (go.shadynotes.app) with a per-day click count.

scripts.stats: wrangler d1 execute golinks --remote --command "SELECT source, content, SUM(n) AS clicks, MIN(day) AS first, MAX(day) AS last FROM clicks GROUP BY source, content ORDER BY clicks DESC"
scripts.daily: wrangler d1 execute golinks --remote --command "SELECT day, source, SUM(n) AS clicks FROM clicks GROUP BY day, source ORDER BY day DESC, clicks DESC LIMIT 200"
